notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
Boss 20 groups the seven spirits: Anger’rel, Dope’rel, Hate’rel, Vile’rel, Seeth’rel, Gloom’rel and Doom’rel.
Speak to Gloom’rel for The Spectral Chalice before starting the encounter.
The small unlabelled rectangle at the bridge spur is Black Forge. It is distinct from Black Anvil on sheet 02.
The two small circles in the Lyceum are braziers; lighting both opens the onward route.
Q15 also serves The Royal Rescue. Rescue quests require sparing Moira; marker 23 identifies her encounter position, not an instruction to kill her.
No post-Vanilla teleporter, Brewfest boss or raid-remake rooms are included.
